lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10 distinct vertical high-contrast white lines are visible. Spacing is relatively equidistant across the mid-torso, with slightly decreased intervals between the posterior-most four lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments 1, 2, and 3 (anterior) terminate abruptly before the ventral fringe. Line segments 8 and 9 (posterior) appear as abbreviated dashes rather than full transverse lines.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A group of approximately 5 high-contrast white spots is clustered on the lower haunch, centered above the stifle joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the mid-posterior flank align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line segment.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a spiral lyrate trajectory, initially diverging laterally from the frontal bone before curving medially and terminating in an upward-pointing vector.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 3.1 times the pixel width of the horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping is visible on the distal ends, comprising approximately 12-15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white dorsal crest/mane extending from the nape to the tail; white transverse chevron marking on the snout; white 'sock' markings on distal limbs terminating at the hooves.
